MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
25004165
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00579025
CARRINGTON MORTGAGE
SERVICES, LLC., is the Plaintiff,
and SELSO N. RODRIGUEZ, ET ALS.,
are Defendants, writ of execution
for the sale of mortgaged premises
dated 12/10/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 25TH DAY of
FEBRUARY A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty o’ clock by the then
prevailing (Standard or Daylight
Saving) time, in the afternoon of
the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick,
N.J. 08901.
All that certain land and premises
situated in the TOWNSHIP OF
PISCATAWAY, County of Middlesex
and State of New Jersey, being
more particularly described as
follow:
Being more commonly known as:
449 RUSHMORE AVENUE, PISCATAWAY, NJ 08854.
Tax Lot: 119.02 F/K/A 119.01, Tax
Block: 108
Dimensions of the Lot: (Approximately) 100.01FT X 72.16FT X
100.00FT X 72.23FT.
Nearest Cross Street: APPROXIMATELY 169.08FT TO THE NEAREST
CROSS STREET KNOWN AS ROCK
AVENUE.
Property Occupancy: Borrower
Occupied on the tax map of the
Township of Piscataway.
The full legal description can be
found in the Office of Middlesex
county in Deed Book 18951, at
Page 1454
APPROXIMATE UPSET AMOUNT IS
$379,832.28 FOR THE SHERIFF SALE
Pursuant to a municipal tax search
dated October 21, 2025.
Subject: 2025 4th quarter taxes due
11/1/2025, $2,155.22 OPEN
2026 1st quarter taxes due
2/1/2026, $2,114.90 OPEN
2026 2nd quarter taxes due
5/1/2026, $2, 114.90 OPEN
Sewer; Acct. 00283000, 7/1/2025 -
12/31/2025, $180.00 OPEN PLUS
PENALTY; $180.00 OPEN PLUS
PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of THREE HUNDRED FORTY
SIX THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED NINE
DOLLARS AND EIGHTY ONE CENTS
($346,509.81) dollars more or less,
plus interest together with the
costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Hill Wallack LLP
21 Roszel Road
PO Box 5226
Princeon, NJ 08540-5226
Attorneys
